Trivia

[edit]
  • Was ranked the 20th best player of 2016 by HLTV. [2]
  • He is the first player to have represented all three top Swedish teams in the 2015 - 2018 era of Global Offensive (Fnatic, Ninjas in Pyjamas and GODSENT).
